theorem lg_target {G : Type v} [Group G] [Finite G] : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat.incl := by
  let J := CategoryTheory.SingleObj G
  let F := FintypeCat.incl
  constructor
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesInitial_and_pushouts
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.hasInitial_of_hasTerminal (by exact CategoryTheory.Limits.hasTerminal_FintypeCat))
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.hasPushouts_of_hasBinaryCoproducts (by exact FintypeCat.hasBinaryCoproducts))
  exact (CategoryTheory.Functor.id_obj J).comp F
